title: SQL AVG() Function
text:
SQL
AVG()
Function



The SQL AVG() Function

The
AVG()
function returns the average value of a numeric column.

The
AVG()
function ignores NULL values in the column.

Note:
NULL values are ignored.

AVG() Syntax

SELECT AVG(
column_name
)
FROM
table_name
WHERE
condition
;
